strategy.name: Pullback to Confluence
strategy.blurb: Buy the pullback into a zone where support, a moving average and volume all line up — the highest-probability entry.

entryPlan.sizingRule: Enter 50% at the first signal (the first pullback to $315.19), then add 30% on a deeper pullback to $306.68, and the final 20% only if it tags $295.15. Never add below the $290.98 cut — that's where the thesis breaks.
